newsitem.title: USA: Morgan's Biggs sees US stocks up 5-10 pct nearterm.
newsitem.headline: Morgan's Biggs sees US stocks up 5-10 pct nearterm.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said global strategist Barton Biggs believes the U.S. stock market "could rally here short-term by five to 10 percent."

Morgan said the influential strategist was impressed by the action in the bond markets in the U.S. and Europe, and action of the dollar given the Fed's decision not to raise short-term interest rates at Tuesday's policy meeting.
The Dow industrials shrugged off earlier losses and rose 20 to 5896 toward midday.
Biggs was not available for further details.
